---
title: "Before the day"
aliases:
  - /tracks/one-day-tools/before.html
---
The day runs in the browser lab, so the one thing that it needs is the lab opened once on the machine you will use. Half of the day is about R, the IDE and the report, though, and if you can install them beforehand, the workspace lets you follow every demonstration on your own machine.

| Work through | What you do | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| [Browser lab](../../cases/eu-frames/lab.qmd) | Open it on the machine and in the browser that you will use, wait for the R engine to load (10 to 30 seconds on a slow connection), and run the cell of Task 1. If it reports 270 rows, 27 countries and 10 years, you are set. | 5 minutes |
| [Case study](../../cases/eu-frames/index.qmd) | The original study, its questions, data and selections; SCORE and the Multi100 project; the five reanalyses, with the software that each used; and how Multi100 put their results on one scale. Every part of the day works on this case. | 60 minutes |
| [Setup](../../setup.qmd) | Optional and recommended. Install R and an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.), download the workspace and run `R/check_setup.R` until it reports no failure. The [help page](../../help.qmd) has the problems that other participants have met, and prompts that you can give an AI assistant. | 30 to 60 minutes, once |
| [Positron, RStudio and VS Code](../../companion/ide.qmd) | Optional, if you installed the workspace. Read section 1 and the section on your IDE, and try the six steps of section 6 in the workspace of this case. | 45 minutes |
| [Getting started with R](../../companion/intro-r.qmd), sections 1 to 4 | Optional. R and the IDE, the console against the script, objects and data frames. The R tutorial of Part 2 starts where these sections end. | 45 minutes |

**By the start of the day** the browser lab loads on your machine, and, if you installed it, the workspace opens in your IDE and its check script reports no failure.
